baseline.method: Independent original execution on exact bound real observations

metric_definition: Relative L2 = ||estimate-reference||_2/||reference||_2 for every declared output; no crop/rescale/alignment.
provenance: See test/validation.md for original-run and numerical precision evidence.
forward_shell_rmse_definition: sqrt(mean((S0*exp(-b*D+b^2*D^2*K/6)-observed_direction_mean)^2)) over all16shells and public b0>40ADU support, in ADU; no normalization or fit alignment.
